notes:
Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.20.2
New feature in Blemish Blaster: Line Blaster. Set end points, thickness, even curve the line to match the line defect and blast that line away.

New weighting system in Stacking Suite. Find the weight option you want in Stacking Suite Settings: Balanced, PSF-Weighted, SNR-Weighted, or Star-Count-Weighted. This will give more weights to the score depending on the options chosen.

Update in Planetary Stacker for planetary de-rotation, Auto Disk button to match the rotation disc, similar in feel to what winjupos does.

Various other bug fixes.
